content.text: In Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are not hypothetical scenarios but daily realities, digital creators face a critical infrastructure problem: how to sell digital products without relying on platforms that reject them. Stripe, PayPal, and even newer alternatives like Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted. The solution lies in sovereign commerce infrastructure—[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-4|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] you own, control, and can deploy anywhere. This post compares two architectures for [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-explained-7|GitHub Pages]].io/store/blog/building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-step-step-deployment-12|building]] a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages: Stack 01 (GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments) and Stack 02 (Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments). Both work, but one is clearly superior for creators in high-pressure environments. We’ll analyze tradeoffs in cost, speed, ownership, and scalability to determine which architecture actually works for you.
What Each Option Actually Offers

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. It’s lightweight, free to deploy, and ideal for creators launching their first store. Stack 02, on the other hand, leverages Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for serverless logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for payments. It’s more robust, scalable, and enterprise-grade. Both stacks deliver automatic crypto payment verification and instant product delivery, but Stack 02 includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration and end-to-end testing. Stack 01 is simpler but limited in scope. Stack 02 is more complex but future-proof. The choice depends on your technical comfort and long-term goals.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Both stacks bypass restrictions by using decentralized payment infrastructure. NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with no KYC, no buyer accounts, and a flat 0.5% fee. Stack 01 relies on Google Apps Script, which works globally but is tied to Google’s terms. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Workers, which operates independently of any single provider. In Zimbabwe, where Google services may face intermittent disruptions, Stack 02’s reliance on Cloudflare’s edge network provides greater reliability. Both stacks use GitHub or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, ensuring your store remains accessible even if local ISPs throttle traffic. However, Stack 02’s architecture is less dependent on third-party platforms, making it the better choice for creators in severely restricted environments.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments verifies payments the moment they confirm on-chain, ensuring instant delivery for buyers. Both stacks support low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON, keeping transaction costs under $0.10. However, Stack 02’s use of Supabase for order storage allows for more sophisticated tracking and analytics, which can be critical for scaling. Stack 01 stores orders in Google Sheets, which is free but less scalable. The real cost difference lies in deployment: Stack 01 is $97, while Stack 02 is $197. For creators selling high-value products or planning to scale, Stack 02’s additional features justify the higher price. For those just starting, Stack 01 offers a low-cost entry point without compromising on payment reliability.
Stack 02’s Cloudflare R2 ensures automated, scalable file delivery—critical for high-volume stores.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With both stacks, you own everything after deployment. COREMERCH has no access to your infrastructure. Stack 01 uses Google Drive for file delivery, which is free but requires manual management. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2, which automates delivery and scales seamlessly. Automation is where Stack 02 pulls ahead: it includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for secure email delivery and end-to-end testing to ensure every component works flawlessly. Stack 01 requires more manual intervention, making it less suitable for creators who cannot afford downtime. If owning your infrastructure means owning its reliability, Stack 02 is the clear winner.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choose Stack 01 if you’re launching your first store, have a limited budget, and need a solution deployed in 48 hours. It’s simple, free to host, and works globally. Choose Stack 02 if you’re selling high-value products, plan to scale, or operate in an environment where reliability is non-negotiable. Its $197 price tag buys you enterprise-grade infrastructure, automated delivery, and future-proof scalability. For creators in Zimbabwe and similar regions, Stack 02’s independence from third-party platforms and its robust architecture make it the better long-term investment. Both stacks deliver sovereignty, but Stack 02 delivers it with fewer compromises.

For digital creators in Zimbabwe, Stack 02 (Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments) is the superior architecture. It offers greater reliability, scalability, and automation compared to Stack 01. While Stack 01 is cheaper and simpler, Stack 02’s enterprise-grade features—like Cloudflare R2 for file delivery and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration—ensure your store operates flawlessly even in restricted environments. If you’re serious about building a sovereign commerce infrastructure that lasts, Stack 02 is the architecture that actually works for you.
NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee and no KYC policy make it the ideal payment layer for restricted regions.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your architecture: Stack 01 for simplicity or Stack 02 for scalability. 2. Deploy backend first: Set up Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. 3. Configure payment layer: Integrate NOWPayments with your chosen backend. 4. Test on mainnet: Ensure payments and deliveries work flawlessly. 5. Promote your store: Use secure email configurations (included in Stack 02) to reach buyers. 6. Monitor performance: Track orders in Google Sheets (Stack 01) or Supabase (Stack 02). 7. Scale as needed: Add more products or upgrade to Stack 02 for advanced features.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use Stack 01 if I’m in Zimbabwe?
Yes, Stack 01 works in Zimbabwe, but it relies on Google services, which may face intermittent disruptions. Stack 02 is more reliable due to its use of Cloudflare’s edge network.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended low-fee networks are BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need technical skills to deploy these stacks?
Basic technical skills are required, but COREMERCH provides detailed documentation and support for both stacks. Stack 01 is simpler, while Stack 02 requires more configuration.
Can I upgrade from Stack 01 to Stack 02 later?
Yes, you can upgrade, but it requires migrating your backend and order storage. Stack 02 is designed for long-term scalability, so starting with it saves time and effort.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments operates on a decentralized network, so downtime is rare. However, both stacks allow you to switch payment providers if needed, ensuring your store remains operational.
Owning your infrastructure means owning its reliability—Stack 02 delivers this without compromise.
